claims.head: Hinds and Luneau get the Lekkerimäki assignment
claims.call: The Ducks’ P2 (Hinds and Luneau) spends at least 31% of its 5-on-5 time against the Canucks’ second line.
claims.body: At home, the Ducks keep sending Hinds and Luneau out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Joel Quenneville has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ second lines. Tonight the Canucks’ second line is Lekkerimäki, Chytil and Öhgren.
claims.nums: At home: 31% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against second lines, about 17% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Joel Quenneville likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Canucks’ second line.
